manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the tabletrashbin for tabletop use and pour it.

Task description: Pick up the white open-top mini trash can at the front right of the table and pour its five red trash balls into the large trash can to the left of the table.

Success criteria: Keep the small bin suspended well above the table while all five red balls leave it and land in the lower collection region inside the large left bin. Merely tilting it, pouring out some balls or leaving balls still falling does not count.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the small bin's straight rim facing the robot with one finger inside and one outside. Contact the wall below the rim and avoid rounded corners to reduce slipping during pouring.
- Match the gripper opening to the rim thickness and available space inside the bin. Before closing, confirm the bin wall is actually between the fingers rather than relying on image overlap or catching a thin rim edge.
- Keep the bin opening facing up during transport, move smoothly, and leave room for the bottom and sides to clear the table edge and objects along the route, avoiding premature spill or collisions.
- If a handoff or grasp adjustment is needed, first set the small bucket upright on the table for support, or have the other gripper hold it securely, before releasing the current grasp. Avoid releasing it unsupported in midair.
- During pouring, place the small bucket's discharge-side rim above the inside of the large bin opening and increase tilt slowly to reduce balls bouncing off the rim. If balls remain, shake gently while keeping the landing point inside the bin.
